sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B: Flagship-Level Coding in a 27B Dense Model
sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-27B is compatible with OpenClaw (formerly Moltbot / Clawdbot), a self-hosted open-source AI coding agent. Connect it to Model Studio to get a full agentic coding experience in the terminal.
